fields.acceptance: A testscript finds `rhiza run start ship-change` on a change set without leaves exiting non-zero with the refusal and `rhiza run start --workflow plan` as next, no run journaled and no worktree made, and the same command on a change set with a leaf starting the run.
fields.statement: `rhiza run start ship-change` refuses a change set with no leaves before writing anything, its next command `rhiza run start --workflow plan`.
